craft_notes: Sthāyin: ground-wonder. Fixed L3 share ('all/issued'). Close: anywhere (negation lands). Rejected: 'veiled' — killed: uncovered kept; 'anyplace' — killed: anywhere plain.

lines: Where all this effect abides, and whence it issued forth —
from being uncovered-formed, no obstruction anywhere.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yatra sthitam idaṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ yasmāc ca nirgataṃ | tasyānāvṛtarūpatvān na nirodho 'sti kutracit

reads_against.argmap: Where this all-effect abides and whence come forth: from being uncovered-formed, no obstruction anywhere.
c1_essence: Where all abides/whence come: uncovered, no obstruction anywhere.
